back: A named block of code for one task that can be called whenever needed (procedure or function).
A subroutine that performs a task and returns no value; run with CALL Name(…).
A subroutine that returns one value; used in an expression, never with CALL.

FUNCTION Name(P : TYPE) RETURNS TYPE
    RETURN value
ENDFUNCTION
A variable in a subroutine's header that receives a value passed in the call; matched by position.
Declared inside a subroutine; usable only there and only while it runs.
Declared in the main program; usable anywhere, including inside subroutines.
Reuse, one place to change, decomposition, separate testing, teamwork.
0478 pseudocode allows up to three parameters per procedure or function.

front: Subroutines in Python and Visual Basic
back: Python: def for both, with return in a function. Visual Basic: Sub (procedure) and Function.
